tasks.title: Spix's Macaw
tasks.instruction: Fill in the missing letters in the paragraph.
tasks.translation: 斯皮克斯金刚鹦鹉原产于巴西，因动画片《里约大冒险》而闻名，现已极度濒危，野外剩余不足一百只。这种充满活力的蓝鸟数量下降，是因为栖息地丧失以及为销往国外而进行的非法诱捕；私人收藏家和宠物商店曾为此花费巨资。保护人士启动了圈养繁殖与栖息地恢复计划，希望将这种鸟重新引入野外——它于 2019 年被正式宣布野外灭绝。

passage.t: The Spix's macaw, native to Brazil and famously known as the inspiration for the animated movie Rio, is critically endangered, with fewer than a hundred individuals remaining. The

collectors and pet stores spent large sums of money on the birds. Conservationists have initiated captive breeding programs and habitat restoration efforts to reintroduce the Spix's macaw into the wild, where it was officially declared extinct in 2019.

layout.title: AI-Generated Art on Campus
layout.body:
Visitors to the Petrunich Gallery can now view an exhibition of AI-generated paintings that blur the line between human creativity and machine learning. One standout work, Dream Algorithm, depicts a city floating in a sea of binary code, while another, Echoes of Light, uses layered brushstrokes created by artificial neural networks to mimic a sunrise over glass towers.

The exhibit, which was funded by an arts innovation grant, allows visitors to interact with a program that generates custom artwork in real time, allowing them to choose themes and color palettes. This feature has become the centerpiece of the show, enchanting everyone from art majors to computer science instructors.

"We're exploring the intersection of creativity and technology," said curator Dana Fields. "It challenges what art means."

"I made a painting with code—it felt empowering," said senior art major Sofia Ramirez. "It's a new frontier."

tasks.title: Parallel Algorithms: From Challenges to Opportunities
tasks.titleZh: 并行算法：从挑战到机遇
tasks.translation: 并行算法是现代计算机中常见的计算方法，通过把任务拆成可同时运行的小部分来加快解题。顺序算法会逐条检查大型数据库，而并行算法可把工作分到多个处理器核心，各自同时检查一部分数据。在医疗领域，并行算法能快速分析大规模数据：研究者模拟病毒在人群中传播时，需要处理感染率、人口统计等上百万个数据点。并行处理后，这些模拟可在数分钟而非数小时内完成，帮助公共卫生官员在疫情中更快决策。但若一次向处理器发送过多数据且缺乏管理，系统反而会变慢。并行算法的优势之一是适应性强。开发者可针对 GPU 等擅长同时处理多项任务的硬件进行优化。这也是深度学习（如面部识别）进展迅速的重要原因：没有并行计算，训练深度学习模型几乎不可能。
paras: Parallel algorithms, a computing method common in modern computers, solve problems faster by dividing a task into smaller parts that run at the same time. Instead of checking every item in a huge database one by one as in a sequential algorithm, a parallel algorithm might split the job across multiple processor cores, each checking a portion of the data simultaneously.

In healthcare, parallel algorithms play a crucial role in analyzing large datasets quickly. When researchers simulate how a virus might spread through a population, they need to process millions of data points—like infection rates and demographics. Using parallel processing, these simulations can run in minutes instead of hours, helping public health officials make faster decisions during outbreaks. However, if too much data is sent to the processors at once without proper management, the system slows down.

One of the strengths of parallel algorithms is their versatility. Developers can tailor them to work efficiently on different types of hardware, such as graphics processing units (GPUs), which are especially good at handling many tasks at once. This is a big reason why deep learning—used in things like facial recognition—has advanced so quickly. Training a deep learning model would be nearly impossible without parallel computing.
